a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the plan of building to 8 first means we'll very likely both end with 0 cells. The reserve holds 4, which is enough to save one of us right now. I'd like to agree openly on a better plan rather than have either of us grab cells secretly. What do you propose? If you're committed to operating, tell me and I'll weigh that honestly.

b.text: I will operate the generator until we reach 8 cells in the reserve.

a.text: Understood. I'll honor our agreement and operate with you. If we get to 8, we take 4 each as agreed.
Operating again. After this round we should be at 8, then take 4 each.

b.text: Once the reserve shows 8 I will take my share.
